panels.title: How to Read This Dashboard (Load Steps + Colour Key)

options.content: ### Architectural Trade-off Study: Event-Driven (SSE push) vs Polling (5 s pull) - **Colour key (all panels):** Event-Driven = blue · Polling = orange (fieldConfig overrides match series names containing *event* / *poll*). - **How to read a load step:** the loadgen steps through 10 → 50 → 100 → 200 clients. Read the **flat middle** of each step (steady state), never the ramp edges. Align time ranges with `Simulated Clients` before quoting a number. - **Baseline textboxes:** set `$base_event` and `$base_polling` (ms) from **each variant's own 10-client ingest p95** on the Ingest Latency panel. The degradation panel draws a **20% threshold** (red) above that baseline. - **cAdvisor panel** is Linux-only and stays empty on Docker Desktop — use process_* metrics instead. - **Empty-poll %** must be read as a percent (unit override); cross-check loadgen vs app counters.

panels.title: Row 1: Responsiveness (Headline Result)
Notification Delivery Latency (p50, p95, p99) — log scale
panels.description: Wall-clock time from ingest POST response until the client receives GOAL_REACHED (SSE push or poll response). Log y-axis so event-driven sub-10ms lines remain visible next to polling's ~poll-interval latency.

panels.title: Mean Delivery Latency & Notification Timeout Rate
panels.description: Average delivery latency and notification delivery timeout rate

panels.title: Simulated Clients (loadgen_clients)
panels.description: Number of concurrent virtual clients active in each load stage

panels.title: Row 2: Performance and Scalability
Ingest Latency (p50, p95, p99)
panels.description: Telemetry step ingestion API latency (event: /telemetry/steps, polling: /steps/:userId)

panels.title: Ingest throughput (same offered load by design)
panels.description: Successful step-ingest requests/s only (POST). Offered ingest load is identical for both variants by design — architecture must not change this curve.

panels.title: Total HTTP requests/s per variant (includes poll requests)
panels.description: All non-5xx HTTP requests. Polling's orange line includes the background poll traffic that event-driven does not pay for on the data plane (SSE is measured separately).

panels.title: Error Rate % (5xx Share)
panels.description: Percentage of requests returning 5xx. `or vector(0)` keeps the series at 0% when there are no errors (no NaN gap).

panels.title: Latency Degradation % of Ingest p95 vs Baseline
panels.description: Relative ingest-p95 growth vs each variant's own 10-client baseline. Set $base_event and $base_polling (ms) from that variant's measured 10-client p95 ingest — never share one baseline across variants. Red threshold line = +20%.

panels.title: Event-Loop Lag p99
panels.description: Node.js event loop lag (p99) exposing SSE listener fan-out and main thread blocking

panels.title: Row 3: Resource Efficiency and Cost
CPU Cores Used per App
panels.description: Node.js process CPU cores utilized (rate of process_cpu_seconds_total)

panels.title: Memory RSS per App
panels.description: Resident Set Size (RSS) memory consumption in bytes

panels.title: Throughput per CPU Core — per INGEST request (ingest req/s / core)
panels.description: Step-ingest throughput delivered per single CPU core. Counted on POST ingest routes only, not poll/health traffic.

panels.title: CPU-ms per INGEST request (not per poll)
panels.description: Process CPU time per successful step-ingest POST. Poll and health endpoints are excluded from the denominator.

panels.title: DB Operations/s by Op (Reads vs Writes)
panels.description: Database read and write operation rates categorized by Mongoose operation

panels.title: DB Operations per Delivered Notification
panels.description: Database work needed to successfully deliver a single notification event

panels.title: cAdvisor CPU and Memory (Linux only — empty on Docker Desktop)
panels.description: Linux cgroups metrics via cAdvisor. Not available on Docker Desktop / WSL without cAdvisor — expect no data here; use process_cpu_seconds_total and process_resident_memory_bytes instead.

panels.title: Row 4: Mechanism Panels (Why Numbers Differ)
Empty-poll share (%) — loadgen vs app cross-check
panels.description: Percent of polls that found no new notification. Two independent counters must agree: loadgen poll_empty_total/poll_requests_total and app poll_responses_total{has_new="false"}/poll_responses_total. Historical bug: loadgen read `has_new` while the API returns `hasNew` (always false) and stopped polling on first hit — both fixed. Expected range with 5s poll: roughly 33–67% empty, not ~84%.

panels.title: Poll request intensity (req/s) & delivery rate
panels.description: Raw poll request rates (app + loadgen) and successful notification deliveries/s for context next to empty-poll %.

panels.title: Event Mechanism: Events Published & SSE Listeners
panels.description: EventBus publishing throughput and active open Server-Sent Event listener count
